content:
Hello! I'm an undergraduate CS student looking to formalize statements about graph parameters and algorithms.

Specifically, I'd like to add various parameters and definitions for trees (such as depth, centroids, and subtrees), as well as methods for performing induction on trees. These definitions would be highly useful for formalizing tree-related divide-and-conquer algorithms.

I have a few questions that I'd like to ask:

  • Is there any work being done concurrently on this topic?
  • What would be the best location to add these definitions? Undirected trees are defined in SimpleGraph.Acyclic, and rooted trees also exist in Quiver.Arborescence.
  • Are these definitions a good fit for mathlib, or should they be a part of a different codebase like cslib?
